v2_human_g2_ac.ac_1: Given that the request asks for all resources, when the system has all available resources, then ensure that at least one is unallocated.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_2: Given that all resources are allocated except for one, when a valid request is made for the one unallocated resource, then reject the request.
v2_human_g2_ac.ac_3: Given that one resource needs to be unallocated, when the system is going to have all resources allocated, then keep the same resource unallocated.

v2_human_g2_constraints.c_1: At least one resource must be unassigned.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_2: Assume that all the previous constraints in the previous task are still valid.
v2_human_g2_constraints.c_3: One resource will be chosen to be unallocated.

v2_human_g2_input:
resources: bitList, value
requests: List[DictCstr, Number]
v2_human_g2_output: Boolean: true if allocation is feasible, false if not
